result.summary: Restored deeper vertical masonry without houses/parks/streets. Replaced the -3 m flat cutoff with a height-based alpha fade from -2.8 to -7 m, pale by day and gradually near-black at night. Normal build/import, full suite, zero light overlaps above eight and six real GPU gradient checks passed. Native A/B overhead was about 0.47–0.61 ms in the sampled view.
